meta.requirement: Explore Windrise (10%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: A Whole Wide World
start.text: ''You see a cart parked under the tree with a line of people in front of it, and you walk over to see what the commotion is about.''

What_s_going_on_here_.text: Mingyu: 50% OFF! 50% OF... oh, hey, I haven't seen you around. Are you looking for the tea or the silk? Tea's nearly gone, though they are a SPECIALTY from Liyue. Everyone's been at it since morning.

choices.label: I'm not buying, sorry. But what is all this?

I_m_not_buying__sorry__But_what_is_all_t.text: Mingyu: What is all this? Let me tell you a secret, buddy. No one in Mondstadt sells this stuff, so I stock up once a season and bring it here. Then I go home with an empty cart and a full purse! One of the benefits of being a merchant, haha!

Is_being_a_merchant_good_.text: Mingyu: Oh yeah, it's the best! You get to travel around and see the world, meet a bunch of new people, and of course you get PAID for it!

I_want_to_do_that_.text:
''She laughs at you.''

Mingyu: Sorry. Sorry, no, that's... sorry.

dotdotdot.text: Mingyu: It's just that it's not a thing you decide to be, you know? Everyone thinks you just buy low, sell high, and that's it. You have to actually KNOW things. What's worth something, what's worth nothing, yada yada. I've watched people lose a whole life's savings because they didn't know what they were looking at!

choices.label: I know my stuff pretty well

I_know_my_stuff_pretty_well.text:
Mingyu: Sure you do.

Mingyu: Well, I guess since I'm in such a wondrous mood, I can help. Bring me twenty Slime Secretions and twenty Stained Masks, and if the quality is actually good, I'll write you up a reference letter for the merchant guild. How does that sound?

Bet.text: Mingyu: I'll be here till the cart's empty. And by the rate my stuff's selling, you might want to be fast!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Mingyu 20 Slime Secretions and 20 Stained Masks at Windrise before her cart sells out (Within 3 hours)

continues.label: Do /rpg again and then click on Bring Mingyu the Materials
(If you take longer than 3 hours) Do /rpg again then click on Bring Mingyu the Materials (Cold)

Bring_Mingyu_the_Materials_Cold.text: ''No one is here. The cart and the busy line is now silent. Maybe you'll need to wait until tomorrow.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Mingyu has packed up. Come back to Windrise after a day has passed to try again

continues.label: Wait for 24 hours, and then do /rpg again and click on Look for Mingyu Again

Bring_Mingyu_the_Materials.text: Mingyu: Oh my my, you actually came back!

Still_working_on_it.text: Mingyu: Might want to hurry up!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Mingyu 20 Slime Secretions and 20 Stained Masks at Windrise before her cart sells out (Within 3 hours)

Got__em.text:
''She goes through the masks one at a time, holding a few up, then putting them down.''

Mingyu: Huh.

Mingyu: Hmmmm, these are actually pretty good. Say, where did you learn to find good quality stuff like this? For a newbie, this isn't bad at all.

Told_you.text:
''She digs a scrap of paper out of the ledger and writes on her knee.''

Mingyu: Alright, well, a deal is a deal. Take this to the merchant guild in Mondstadt City. My name's on it, and it should be a pretty good reference letter.

Mingyu: Go and ask for a trading license!

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Bring Mingyu's letter to the merchant guild in Mondstadt City

continues.label: Go to Mondstadt City (Mondstadt), do /rpg and click on Visit the Merchant Guild

Visit_the_Merchant_Guild.text:
''The guild hall smells like paper.''

Guild Clerk: Mingyu wrote this? Hm.

Guild Clerk: You're here to register as a merchant? The fee is 200 Silver.

gimme_a_min.text: Guild Clerk: Let me know when you've got it.

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Pay the 200 Silver permit fee at the merchant guild in Mondstadt City

____A_Whole_Wide_World__Licensed_Merchan.title: Licensed Merchant
____A_Whole_Wide_World__Licensed_Merchan.text:
''He counts it, stamps something, and slides a small license across the counter.''

Guild Clerk: You're registered.

Guild Clerk: Next!

''Use [/rpg trade] while at the same location as another adventurer who has a trading license.''
